repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The IR specifies a cycle that repeats indefinitely (until is null). The candidate incorrectly includes an 'else' branch that re-executes the body actions on every iteration. At t=60000, the IR emits only the email action (cycle body), while the candidate emits both the valve close and the email action (from the else branch), causing a mismatch.
diagnosis.change_summary: Removed the 'else' block entirely. The IR cycle body must run on every iteration without re-executing the initial wait or the valve close action. The script now correctly executes the email send action on every 60-second iteration.
